newsitem.title: CHINA: Timetable for Tuesday's funeral of China's Deng.
newsitem.headline: Timetable for Tuesday's funeral of China's Deng.

text.p: The following is the timetable of the official memorial service on Tuesday for Chinese paramount leader Deng Xiaoping at the Great Hall of the People on Beijing's Tiananmen Square.
6:54 a.m. (2254 GMT) - Daily flag-raising ceremony at Tiananmen Square, timed to coincide with sunrise.
7:30 a.m. (2330 GMT) - Martial law security provisions take effect in the square, barring unauthorised people from entering the area.
9:50 a.m. (0150 GMT) - Top leaders including President Jiang Zemin and Premier Li Peng join 10,000 official mourners in the Great Hall's main auditorium, where Deng's ashes lie in state.
10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) - Whistles and horns on trains, ships and warships and in factories across China are to be sounded for three minutes to mark nationwide mourning.

10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) - Official start of the memorial ceremony, which will be broadcast live by radio and television around the world. Jiang, Deng's hand-picked successor, is expected to deliver the eulogy.
11:00 a.m. (0300 GMT) (approximately) - Memorial service ends; leaders, family members and other mourners leave the Great Hall, martial law provisions lifted at Tiananmen Square.
